title: College admissions advice platform
summary: Affordable expert admissions advice for every student.
whyTempting: Admissions are high-stakes and consulting is expensive.
whyItFails: Trust. Parents want proven human consultants. Seasonal. Demand is concentrated. One-time customers. No repeat business.
whatWouldChange: AI feedback on essays at low cost, with human premium tiers.

attempts.notes: College reviews, admissions advice and counselling portal.

reasons.detail: Trust: Parents want proven human consultants.
